title: Autotune: batching & KV-caching recommendations with safe-apply and rollback for Private/VPC
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description: Add an autotune subsystem that suggests and (optionally) applies batching and KV-cache configuration tweaks in Private/VPC/on-prem deployments. Must enforce safe defaults, support offline/dry-run modes, and provide atomic apply/rollback with auditable policy checks for restricted environments.
acceptance_criteria: Autotune engine generates deterministic recommendations for batching (batch size, max latency target, batching window) and KV-cache (prefix caching on/off, TTL heuristics) based on historical traces in Private deployments
UI and CLI expose a dry-run mode that shows expected cost savings, latency changes, and safety score, without applying changes to runtime
A safe-apply flow enforces org policy: for Private/VPC, requires operator approval or signed policy allowlist before applying; for on-prem air-gapped, allow only offline artifact import method
Apply is atomic and can be rolled back by a single operation within 24 hours, restoring previous runtime config and model variant pins
All applies, rollbacks, and recommendation exports are recorded to audit logs compatible with KMS-wrapped signatures and conform to RBAC checks
E2E tests covering canary rollout (10% traffic), failed canary automatic rollback, and manual rollback succeed in lab environment
implementation_steps: Design recommendation engine: offline analysis job that consumes trace logs (token-level latencies, seq length distribution, cache hit rates)
Add policy layer for Private: policy types include allowlist, operator-approve, and offline-import; integrate with existing RBAC and KMS hooks
Expose dry-run API and Console view showing delta metrics and confidence intervals
Implement safe-apply transaction: snapshot current runtime config, apply new batching/cache settings in canary nodes, monitor SLOs for 15 minutes, then promote
Implement rollback: revert snapshot across nodes with zero-downtime plan and KV-cache rewarm if needed
Add audit record format and sign artifacts for air-gapped export/import
Build integration tests using private-mode testbed and simulate failure modes (network partition, registry errors, policy denial)
notes_and_decisions: We will restrict automatic apply in Private mode to operator-approved or allowlisted customers. Fully autonomous applies allowed only in hosted mode.
Safe defaults chosen: conservative batching window (max 10ms), max batch size defaults to 8 for CPU-backed on-prem nodes, and disabled speculative cache eviction unless TTL confidence >= 0.8
For air-gapped on-prem, recommendation bundles include signed manifest + instruction set to apply via offline tooling. CI cannot directly push to those clusters.
We will reuse the existing runtime snapshot mechanism from ENG-6992 to implement atomic apply/rollback
We will require security sign-off due to policy enforcement and audit traceability (security_review_required=true)
risks_and_mitigation: Risk: mis-applied batch settings could increase latency for tail requests -> Mitigation: canary rollout with SLO gating and automatic rollback on >5% SLA breach
Risk: KV-cache changes may invalidate privacy guarantees in Private deployments -> Mitigation: policy validation ensures cache only enabled for non-sensitive prefixes and honors prefix allowlist
Risk: operator confusion in offline import -> Mitigation: provide step-by-step CLI helper and dry-run verification, plus human-readable signed manifest
Risk: audit/logging volume grows -> Mitigation: compress recommendation artifacts and retain signed manifests, sample detailed traces only on request
qa_tests: Run recommendation job against 30-days test trace and verify recommendations match manual baseline in 90% of scenarios
Perform end-to-end canary apply in private-lab, validate SLOs for 30 minutes, then promote; verify rollback reverses metrics
Simulate policy denial: attempt apply blocked by allowlist; ensure no changes and clear error returned
Air-gap test: export signed bundle, import via offline tool, apply on isolated cluster, verify audit signature validation
next_steps: Draft PRD for product review (link in links) and schedule security review by 2025-03-21
Spin up private-lab env with 3 canary nodes and baseline trace generator
Create GitHub feature branch and open PR for recommendation engine and dry-run API
Coordinate with Console team for new dry-run UI panel and operator approval flow
